headline: Bam Bam Cevichería Success Story
subheadline: From Carriage Stand to Restaurant Chain
author: Marco Medrano
content: In 2012, following two years unemployed post my mother's passing, alongside my father, we initiated a small stand behind Mercado Norte selling ceviche. My participation in ‘Ceviche con Sentimiento,’ where I reached finals, taught valuable business insights leading us here. Initial challenges included securing startup funds which were overcome thanks to supportive acquaintances who helped secure early clients allowing gradual investment expansion. Our commitment lies in delivering exceptional services right from entry till exit ensuring varied menu options catered specifically according to client preferences. Today, supported by dedicated team members trained over time focusing on excellence and warmth defines our operations.
